blockers.summary: Seven pinned source archives and independent WASM are verified. All 14 directly scanned ALWIS native C inputs now carry GPL-2.0-only SPDX, with author history and maintainer claim recorded. Exact linked third-party object/source/license correspondence remains unaudited for a release.

Separate TypeScript/SWC editor and GPLv2 native WASM build artifacts are evidenced and checked in provenance/editor-license-boundary.md. Legal classification of the complete distributed work and its interactions is not yet confirmed.

For currently unidentified ALWIS code the maintainer claims original authorship; Git history and source study comparisons are recorded. A missing match is not proof of originality; third-party adaptations/assets and ownership still require a final attribution check.

Static notices and candidate corresponding sources are verifiable; independently compiled SHA 39f4b5d6cf785adafd5f994d11b88b491b7dcc21dbfedbefe896b871f5f4f6b6 passed all 17 browser parity probes in both Chromium and Firefox (Actions 42844495555). Final distribution-specific notices, source/binary SBOM, permission review and independent-candidate multi-client native end-to-end testing are outstanding; historical witness multi-client testing passed Actions 42849610482. A parity success does not authorize publication.

scope: This status blocks publication of static, Docker, and native releases containing the runtime. It does not prevent local development or validation builds.
reopenWhen: Update this file only after evidence for each blocker is recorded in provenance/component-license-map.md and the exact release notices/source bundle are verified.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Withdrawn: historical patches/NOTICE explicitly licenses the engine patch and modified glue GPL-2.0-only. Repository-root Apache-2.0 was incorrectly applied to these files.
